subject: general
question: Among five friends Aman, Baman, Chaman, Karan and Tapan, Chaman is older than only one friend. Tapan is older than Karan. Only two persons are older than Karan. Baman is older than Tapan. Who is the youngest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Five friends Aman, Baman, Chaman, Karan and Tapan. 

Chaman is older than only one friend. 

__ > __ > __ > Chaman > __

Only two persons are older than Karan.

__ > __ > Karan > Chaman > __

Tapan is older than Karan.

Baman is older than Tapan. 

Baman > Tapan > Karan > Chaman > __

And, Aman is the youngest among all, because no other place left for Aman.

Baman > Tapan > Karan > Chaman > Aman

So, '**Aman**' is the youngest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Aman"**.
